title: Fix a boundary bug
description: A pagination function has an off-by-one in its slice-index arithmetic that drops the last item of every page (a different boundary-bug flavor than T02's threshold-comparison bug - here the bug is in index arithmetic, not a comparison operator).

expected_output_contract.notes: 6 tests total; a correct fix makes all 6 pass. The unfixed source already passes 2/6 (the two cases the off-by-one happens not to affect).
